headline: Store Manager till Malmö, Mobilia
description_text: Letar du efter en arbetsplats för framtiden? Stores i Telenor är en av våra viktigaste säljkanaler som utgör cirka 40 % av all försäljning. Uppdraget för en Store Manager är att tillsammans med kollegorna skapa en välfungerande butik. För att trivas i denna roll brinner du för ledarskap och försäljning som däri innefattar totalansvar inom Stores på en lokal marknad. Om du brinner för att bli Telenors lokala hub för både konsumenter och företagare samt älskar försäljning, människor och ledarskap - då är detta rollen för dig! Vad gör en Store Manager? Du har fullt ansvar för butiken, vilket innebär all försäljning, rekrytering, medarbetarutveckling samt att samtliga kampanjer och nya produkter förs ut på bästa sätt Eget försäljningsansvar samtidigt som du leder och säkerställer att medarbetarna i butiken når sina och butikens mål Du blir en av våra primära Telenor ambassadörer mot såväl konsument som företagskunder Du utvecklar och bygger teamet lokalt i nära samarbete med Learning Lab Du ansvarar tillsammans med dina kollegor för att rutiner och kvalitet följs i enlighet med policys, vad gäller exempelvis inventering, lagerhållning och säkerhet Du utvecklar och skapar kontakter med kollegor inom Stores samtidigt som du säkerställer en gruppdynamik inom din butik som är framgångsrik Du ansvarar även för schemaläggning, kostnadsmål, drift och kundklagomål i butiken. Är du vår nya Store Manager? Vi söker dig som fullkomligt brinner för ledarskap och försäljning. Du stimuleras av att coacha andra och bidrar gärna med din erfarenhet till dina kollegor. Du är duktig på att hantera olika typer av personligheter och du är en teamspelare av rang. Vidare är du en god organisatör med en problemlösningsförmåga och inställning att allt är möjligt. Vi ser att du har ett genuint intresse när det gäller försäljning och tillväxt såväl mot konsument som mot företag. För att trivas med jobbet måste du tycka om att vara nära medarbetarna, bidra med egen försäljning och även vilja vara en del av bemanningen i butiken. Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av liknande bransch sedan tidigare samt om du haft en ledande position. Våra löften till dig Vi är bättre tillsammans . Hos oss möts du av en familjär och inkluderande kultur, en stark gemensam värdegrund och ett ledarskap som ger dig frihet och handlingskraft. Vi tror på att ge varandra förtroende och frihet att agera och fatta beslut, samtidigt som vi är där för varandra i med- och motgångar. Vi stöttar relationer och samhällen . Telenor är ett samhällsbärande företag och här får ditt arbete ett större syfte. Vi skapar värde för miljoner människor varje dag och har ett kundnära förhållningssätt där mänskliga relationer står i centrum. Vi ger plats för livet . Vi finns där genom livets alla faser och erbjuder trygghetspaket i form av bl.a. kollektivavtal, tjänstepension, friskvårdsbidrag och möjlighet att skräddarsy försäkringslösningar som passar just dig, för ditt behov här och nu. Som tillsvidareanställd har du dessutom vår förmån "två give-me-a-break-days" per år som ger dig en extra paus med möjlighet till återhämtning och välmående. Vi bjuder in till en spännande karriärresa . Din utveckling står i centrum och hos oss är lärande en del av kulturen. I butikerna fokuserar vi på att coacha, utveckla och ge dig rätt verktyg för att trivas och växa. Telenor erbjuder både fysiska och digitala utbildningar anpassade för just din utvecklingsresa. Genom Växa, vår utbildningsplattform, och andra lärandeinitiativ får du därmed möjligheten att utvecklas och forma din egen karriär. Majoriteten av våra tjänster tillsätts internt så när du vill vidare väntar möjligheterna här. Sök till oss idag Vill du ta ditt nästa steg i karriären med oss? Vi ser fram emot din ansökan! Vi träffar kandidater löpande så hör av dig redan idag. Observera att vi inte tar emot ansökningar via mejl. Bra att känna till Om du går vidare i rekryteringsprocessen kommer du få göra tre tester som fokuserar på din personlighet och dina färdigheter. Syftet med testerna är att vi på ett rättvist och objektivt sätt ska bedöma dina kompetenser i förhållande till tjänsten. Enligt Telenors policy genomför vi även bakgrundskontroll på slutkandidat i samtliga rekryteringar.

headline: Redigerare till Svenska Dagbladet
description_text: Vill du vara med och forma Svenska Dagbladets morgontidning – både i print och digitalt? Nu söker vi två erfarna redigerare för tillsvidareanställning. eSvD- och printnavet ansvarar för planering, produktion och publicering av Svenska Dagbladets papperstidning och digitala tidning eSvD. Hos oss får du arbeta nära kärnan i SvD:s journalistik och vara med och utveckla några av Sveriges mest uppskattade nyhetsprodukter. Du blir en del av ett erfaret team där kvalitet, samarbete och nytänkande står i fokus. Navet består av teamledare, redigerare och produktionskoordinatorer som tillsammans ser till att våra tidningsprodukter håller hög kvalitet – från dagens första nyhetsartikel till sista korrekturet. I rollen som redigerare jobbar du dagligen med paketering av kvalitetsjournalistik i papperstidningen och eSvD. Du är delaktig i utvecklingen av våra produkter och verktyg och bidrar till att förbättra hur journalistiken presenteras för våra läsare. Vid behov tar du rollen som arbetsledare och stöttar det dagliga redaktionella arbetet. I din roll kommer du att: Redigera och paketera journalistik för både print och eSvD, framför allt inom våra bevakningsområden nyheter, näringsliv och kultur, men även sport och feature. Säkerställa hög kvalitet i texter, bilder, grafik och illustrationer. Jobba både i breaking news-tempo och med planerad förproduktion. Nyhetsvärdera material och händelser samt göra redaktionella prioriteringar utifrån dagens nyhetsläge. Vi söker dig som har: Mångårig erfarenhet som redigerare på dagstidning. God nyhetskänsla och vana att fatta redaktionella beslut i ett högt tempo. Vilja att bidra till utvecklingen av våra produkter och arbetssätt. Erfarenhet av publiceringsverktyg för print och webb (kunskaper i Aptoma och InDesign är meriterande). God förmåga att hantera flera arbetsuppgifter parallellt. Känsla för språkvård och formgivning. Journalistutbildning. Upplysningar om tjänsterna: Tjänsterna är tillsvidareanställningar på Svenska Dagbladet, som är en del av den internationella mediekoncernen Schibsted. Sysselsättningsgraden är heltid. Vi arbetar på redaktionen i Stockholm och det finns viss möjlighet till hybridarbete. Tillträde sker enligt överenskommelse. För frågor om tjänsten kontakta tf navchef Jenny Danielsson, jenny.danielsson@svd.se . För fackliga frågor kontakta SJF:s fackklubb på SvD: sjf@svd.se . Sista ansökningsdag är 3 juli. Urval sker löpande.

headline: Head of Security & Resilience, Schibsted
description_text: We are looking for a strategic and hands-on Head of Security & Resilience to lead and shape the future of security across Schibsted and all our brands. This is a unique opportunity to build the structures, governance, policies, and capabilities that support some of the Nordic region’s most influential media organizations - where security, freedom of expression, and editorial independence go hand in hand. About the Role As Head of Security, you will have overall responsibility for developing, coordinating, and continuously strengthening security across Schibsted. You will be the central leader and coordinator for the organization's security agenda, ensuring that security risks are managed holistically across multiple functions, brands, and business areas. You will be part of Schibsted Group and report to Håkan Halvarsson. Key Responsibilities Define and lead the overall security strategy, governance framework, policies, and standards across the organization. Own and coordinate the Group’s crisis management capability, ensuring effective preparedness, response, recovery, and continuous improvement. Ensure that local crisis management teams, plans, procedures, and exercises are established and maintained within each brand and business unit. Chair and coordinate a cross-functional Security Steering Committee, ensuring alignment and collaboration across the organization's key security domains: Crisis Management Editorial Security (owned locally by each newsroom) Cyber Security (led by the Technology organization) Physical Security (managed by Facilities, including access control, building protection, fire safety, and evacuation preparedness) Communication related to crisis management and security Drive coordination across these security disciplines to ensure risks, dependencies, and mitigation efforts are managed consistently and effectively. Partner closely with Facilities to ensure workplace and office security standards are maintained and continuously improved. Develop and strengthen the framework for editorial security in close collaboration with editorial leadership and external security specialists. Ensure there is a process for security assessments and risk evaluations for major events, productions, and public-facing activities. Ensure there is a process for monitoring geopolitical developments, societal trends, and emerging threats that may impact our people, operations, brands, and journalistic mission. Advise senior leadership on security risks, crisis preparedness, and resilience-related matters. We believe you are: An experienced security leader with the ability to combine strategic vision with operational execution. Experienced in crisis management, risk management, protective security and organizational resilience. Comfortable operating in complex, matrixed organizations and influencing stakeholders across multiple functions and leadership levels. Skilled at building governance structures and driving alignment across diverse security disciplines. A confident communicator with sound judgment, high integrity, and the ability to remain calm under pressure. Passionate about protecting people, operations, and the values that underpin independent journalism and free media. Why Schibsted? At Schibsted, you will work at the heart of the Nordic media landscape, alongside people who are passionate about journalism, technology, and societal impact. You will have a highly visible leadership role with significant responsibility, strong executive support, and the opportunity to make a real difference in protecting the people, operations, and values that enable independent media to thrive. This is an opportunity to shape and mature security capabilities across multiple leading media brands at a time when resilience, trust, and freedom of expression have never been more important. We evaluate candidates continuously, and the position may be filled before the application deadline. Schibsted is covered by a collective bargaining agreement. Our democracies depend on independent journalism. That’s our business.

headline: Pensionsspecialist Uttagsplanering Pension
description_text: Vill du jobba i ett framgångsrikt team som brinner för att ytterligare stärka Swedbanks tjänstepensionsaffär? Genom ett rådgivningsverktyg hjälper du som pensionsspecialist kunden att ta fram en individuellt utformad uttagsplan. Rådgivningen omfattar kundens samtliga pensionstillgångar. Hos oss kan du uppleva: Personlig och professionell utveckling genom självledarskap och kontinuerlig utveckling. Meningsfullt arbete som positivt påverkar vår arbetsplats, våra kunder och samhället. En öppen och samarbetsinriktad kultur som uppmuntrar tvärfunktionellt teamarbete och erbjuder nätverksmöjligheter. En stöttande och inkluderande miljö som främjar en balanserad och hållbar arbetslivssituation, med flexibla arbetsförhållanden när det passar rollen. Förmåner såsom vårt erbjudande för bankprodukter för anställda, tjänstepensionsplan, aktiebaserade belöningsprogram Eken, och frivillig gruppförsäkring. "Bli en del av vårt team och... med professionella kollegor, som arbetar tillsammans för att leverera bästa möjliga service både mot kund och kollegor i banken. Som maximerar kundnöjdheten och bidrar till Swedbanks position i samhället. ” Erik Virdeborn, din framtida chef Vi ser fram emot din ansökan senast den 2026-07-03. headline: Head of Fraud Detection
description_text: Are you interested in leading people At Swedbank, we believe that successful leaders enable us to realize our strategy Your responsibilities: Overseeing fraud detection for both cards and payments Define, implement, and continuously improve detection capabilities and performance Lead fraud rules design and analytical development for cards and payments, balancing fraud risk mitigation, customer experience, and business impact. Work with strategic direction of strengthening fraud prevention in Swedbank Assessing and improving the performance of your team members Building a diverse team with high level of team spirit and engagement What is needed in this role: Proven experience in leadership capabilities and the ability to quickly adapt and work in a transformative environment. Knowledge about fraud prevention in Swedbank and experience from leading projects and teams. Understanding how fraud prevention corresponds to the strategic direction, including customer protection and the prioritized goals for Swedbank on an overall level. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with fluency in English and Swedish Understanding how to achieve results through others and take accountability for your team members’ and the team’s performance Ability to assess and improve performance Good communication and collaboration with others Contribute to the team members’ well-being and sustainable performance Bachelor’s or Master’s degree With us, you can experience: Personal and professional growth through self-leadership and continuous development. A supportive and inclusive environment that promotes a balanced and sustainable work-life, with flexible working conditions when suitable for the role. Benefits such as our share based reward program Eken, company pension plan, employee offer for banking products, health insurance. " This is our team... Collaboration is at the heart of what we do-we partner closely across teams and departments to strengthen fraud prevention efforts and ensure a secure and trusted experience for our Customers.” Björn Johansson , your future leader We look forward to receiving your application by 13.07.2026. headline: Head of Tech Sweden, Group Payments & Accounts
description_text: Are you passionate about leadership and delivering first class Payment & Accounts products that are critical for our customers and society at large? Be instrumental in leading and driving the Tech unit’s execution of the current transformation plan, as well as the strategy going forward. Be a leader of leaders who builds trust, inspires people, and shows courage. Promote and nurture a strong collaboration culture across the different units within the bank to accelerate our business goals and joint commitment. Aligning your work and the unit’s contribution to the bank’s strategic direction. headline: Head of Privacy to Swedbank Pay
description_text: Stronger together - Join our team As one of the top companies for payment solutions in the Nordic region, we offer a stimulating and creative work environment. We’re always open to new ideas and ways of doing things, while also striving to make things simpler and easier for our customers. At Swedbank Pay, you can develop and expand your competence while working alongside engaging leaders and colleagues. If you’re looking to be challenged in your role and be part of a strong professional community, then this may be the workplace for you. We are now looking for a Head of Privacy. You will be part of small but specialized team and report directly to our Head of Legal Swedbank Pay. Privacy is part of our legal team and you will be working with Swedbank Pay data protection issues and, when needed, support in other legal areas, all in close collaboration with highly engaged colleagues. As Head of Privacy you will be responsible for the company’s privacy function and become a key person in our legal team. We are looking for someone that: Enjoys working within data privacy and wants to develop and grow as part of the Swedbank Pay team. The role of Head of Privacy is both strategic and operational. You will, among other things, be supporting Swedbank Pay in operational GDPR-related work such as maintaining register of processing activities, performing DPIA and LIA, incident and breach management, assisting in the preparation and not least the implementation of group-wide guidelines, policies and instructions. More about the position The role of the Head of Privacy is to: Continuously monitor the Data Privacy Landscape relevant for Swedbank Pay Create and establish policies and procedures for Swedbank Pay based on legal requirements Ensure that Data Privacy related contracts are in line with Swedbank Pay standards Collaborate and consult with the legal department to ensure key legal/compliance issues are identified and mitigated Lead and coordinate Swedbank Pay operational GDPR-related work More specifically the Head of Privacy should: Support Swedbank Pay Legal and negotiate client and supplier facing privacy-related documents such as data processing agreements, data transfer agreements and data protection clauses. Provide ongoing GDPR support to the business Establish, update, distribute and implement internal control documents Monitor the development and practice in the regulatory area and assist in the implementation of new rules Be responsible for updating and maintaining the company's register of processing of personal data, map documents and processes, handle data subject right requests, and lead the incident and breach management support. Create Data Privacy information material for relevant stakeholders Support Data Processing related initiatives and be part of product development teams Guide Purchase and Sales teams within contract reviews and negotiations Support the Data Protection Officer during Data Privacy related analyses Define Data Subject, Data ownership, Incident and Breach documentation and standards reflecting global and local requirements Review and evaluate received Data Subject Access Request and Privacy Breach Alerts, assist in handling such and to ensure that necessary documentation is prepared We are looking for someone that has: Minimum 4-5 years of Data Privacy experience Master’s degree in law Working knowledge of Information Security principles and practices Project management skills Computer Technology-related legislation experience Familiarity with the financial services industry We also think it’s good if you have: Strong stakeholder management skills and strategic understanding of business clients' needs Excellent verbal and written communication skills at all levels Self-motivated, organized, and able to work under pressure and meet deadlines Effective planning, implementation, and change support Ability to manage time, priorities, and collaborate with remote teams Fluent in English and Swedish (knowledge of other Nordic languages is a plus) Positive attitude towards learning and development To succeed in the role, you have the ability to plan and work independently and appreciate working in a cross-discipline environment where change is a part of everyday life. It is easy for you to familiarize yourself with details but at the same time focus on the big picture. You have a genuine interest and curiosity to understand the challenges and a mind to find the solutions that are a good fit both for Swedbank Pay and the customer. What can we offer you? Working alongside driven and inspiring colleagues, you get to be a part of Swedbank Pay Legal function and get the opportunity to drive, develop and support the Swedbank Pay privacy work. Want to be our head of Privacy? Send us your application today! The position is full time and begins according to agreement. Location: Stockholm The last day to apply is 2026-07-10. Applications are confidential. Candidate selection and interviews are on-going and the position may be filled prior to the last day to apply. For questions about this position, please contact Peter Eriksson, Head of Legal Swedbank Pay peter.eriksson@swedbankpay.se Swedbank Pay does not discriminate anybody based on gender, age, sexual orientation or sexual identity, ethnicity, religion or disability – everybody is welcome. We value the qualities that a diverse group of people brings to our business. In order to be as open-minded as possible in our recruitment, we use anonymization of the CV. We also ask you to exclude: name, age, gender and photos in your personal letter. As part of our recruitment process, we validate identity and conduct background checks to ensure a secure hiring experience. Please note that we have already chosen our recruitment channels and therefore do not wish to be approached by external recruitment firms or ad sellers. Swedbank Pay specialises in payment solutions for resellers and e-commerce, and is dedicated to creating a world where payments between buyers and sellers are as safe and as simple as possible – whether it’s online or in person. We are driven by innovation and our ambition to help people, businesses, and society grow. Today, we are one of the leading companies within payment solutions that operates in Sweden, Norway, Denmark, and Finland. Something that wouldn’t have been possible without our passionate and skilled co-workers! Our organisation and everything we do is built on our core values: Open, Simple, and Caring. #LI-DNI

headline: Roslagens Sparbank söker Paralegal
description_text: Är du en strukturerad och serviceinriktad person med ett genuint intresse för juridik och administration? Nu har du möjligheten att bli en del av Roslagens Sparbanks juridikenhet. Du ges utrymme att bredda och fördjupa din kompetens inom flera områden och bidrar aktivt till att banken möter såväl affärsmässiga som regulatoriska krav. Hos oss blir du en del av en lokal och samhällsengagerad bank med korta beslutsvägar och ett starkt fokus på långsiktiga relationer. För att trivas och lyckas i rollen ser vi att du är noggrann, ansvarsfull och van att arbeta självständigt med ett stort mått av eget ansvar. Din profil · YH-utbildning som Paralegal eller annan eftergymnasial utbildning med juridisk inriktning. Motsvarande arbetslivserfarenhet kan också vara relevant. · God förmåga att uttrycka dig i tal och skrift på svenska och engelska. · Stark administrativ förmåga och hög noggrannhet. · Du gillar att skapa ordning och se till att arbetet blir korrekt och genomfört i tid. · Du är trygg i digitala verktyg och arbetar gärna i Word, Excel och olika system. · Du är serviceinriktad och lösningsorienterad med förmåga att arbeta såväl självständigt som i team. · Erfarenhet av arbete inom bank, finans, försäkring eller annan reglerad verksamhet är meriterande. Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på heltid med inledande provanställning. Tillträde sker snarast möjligt eller enligt överenskommelse. Huvudsaklig placering i Norrtälje, men du kan komma att arbeta på bankens övriga kontor i Norrtälje kommun. headline: Senior Release Manager
description_text: Cambio is one of the Nordics' leading suppliers in e-health with a comprehensive offering for the entire health and care chain. Our e-health solutions supports health care professionals in their daily work and offer patients safer and more easily accessible care. We are proud to be an important part of Swedish healthcare. We are growing continuously and now have about 1000 employees in several countries. The position As a Senior Release Manager, you will be part of the team that designs, builds, and maintains the release process at Cambio. In this key role, you will help establish a modern approach to release management and play an important part in shaping the way we work. You will also contribute to our service journey, with great opportunities to influence the next generation of Cambio’s healthcare solutions. The Release Management team is responsible for planning and coordinating how Cambio’s systems and services evolve to meet changing business needs. This involves managing internal and external changes across all environments until they are ready for end-user consumption. The primary goal of release management is to ensure that new functionality is delivered to end users in accordance with policies and customer agreements. As a Senior Release Manager at Cambio, you will take ownership of managing and continuously improving our Service Release capability—driving efficiency, quality, and reliability throughout the process. Collaborate across functions with technical teams, project managers, and customer-facing roles, gaining a deep understanding of the entire delivery process and building strong professional networks. Join a highly skilled and supportive team that values collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement. At Cambio, we encourage taking iniatives that contributes to the development of the company and ourselves. For us, it is important that you should have the opportunity to grow, both as a person and as a employee. Our culture is describes through the words "Trust", "Care" and "Together" which permeate everything we do. About you You are a curious and driven person who is eager to learn and expand your knowledge. With strong communication skills, you feel comfortable engaging with stakeholders at all levels of the organization. Outgoing and confident, you combine solution- and service-oriented thinking with the ability to make clear decisions while considering multiple perspectives. While you possess a natural sense of authority, you value collaboration and strive to be a true team player. Efficiency, engagement, and flexibility define your way of working. You enjoy being innovative and thrive in a global context where adaptability and creativity are key. Requirements Experience working with release management or IT project management, preferably in environments involving system and service delivery Solid understanding of ITIL release process Experience from enterprise production deliveries Experience in working with Agile methodologies Excellent communication skills in English It's a bonus if you Certified within ITIL Documented experience of implementing ITIL processes on a broader scale within an organization Have experience from Jira ITSM tool (JSM) Have experience working with a product and service provider within the healthcare sector. Additional information: We will start the selection process after the holidays and you will hear from us no later than week 3. Place of employment : Stockholm or Linköping Scope : Full-time, hybrid work model (three days per week in-office) Form of employment: Permanent employment, 6 months trial period We look forward to receiving your application! CAMBIO- FOR A HEALTHIER TOMORROW Welcome to a company where healthcare is improved every day. headline: IT Operations Specialist
description_text: Stories have the power to make the ordinary extraordinary. They help us think bigger, see beyond ourselves, and deepen our connection with others. As one of the world's leading audiobook and e-book streaming platforms, Storytel brings unlimited listening to millions of users across 25 markets. Driven by our purpose, "Leading the future of storytelling, we move the world through stories", Storytel Group inspires and entertains people around the world by blending innovation with tradition. We bring stories to life across various formats for everyone to discover. Anytime. Anywhere. Ready for your next chapter? We're looking for an IT Operations Specialist to join our team in Stockholm! About the Role Do you want to architect, develop, and take technical ownership of modern cloud Digital Workplace platforms while remaining hands-on, managing daily operations and handling routine workplace IT tasks? The IT Operations team is currently scaling our responsibilities and operations. While Storytel’s core IT landscape is primarily built around Google Workspace and macOS, we are in an exciting phase where we are taking over the IT responsibility for companies within the group that mainly operate on Microsoft 365. We are looking for this role to act as the technical bridge for this expansion, which brings an exciting increase in technical complexity, multi-tenant environments, and global reach. In this role, you will step into a vital and highly versatile position. While your primary focus will be acting as our internal driver for MDM and Microsoft 365 governance, this is a broad role where you will manage and work across a wide array of different systems, applications, processes, and projects. Simultaneously, you will remain hands-on, supporting the team in daily operations and taking ownership of Workplace IT. Growth & Opportunities For an ambitious candidate who successfully takes ownership and elevates our MDM and M365 environments, there are great opportunities to gradually shape the role and dive deeper into specialized infrastructure engineering and governance as our landscape evolves. Core Responsibilities MDM Evolution & Management: Take ownership of managing and developing our device management across our hybrid device fleet with Microsoft Intune and Jamf. You will architect, build, and maintain secure device configurations while also focusing on creating a great user experience with a distinct Storytel look and feel across all endpoints. M365 & Identity Governance: Architect, configure, and manage our Microsoft 365 environments within a complex multi-tenant structure. These environments are tightly integrated with Okta as part of an advanced identity architecture, utilizing HRiS as a Source SaaS System Administration: Daily administration, user lifecycle management, and optimization of various SaaS systems used and provided across the group. IT Projects & Continuous Improvement: Actively lead and execute various internal IT projects. You will be a driving force behind onboarding new group environments and constantly leveling up our technical setup. Vendor Management & Procurement: Manage relationships and contracts with external IT vendors, hardware suppliers, and SaaS providers. You will oversee software licensing, optimize procurement processes, and ensure we partner with the right external stakeholders. Operational & Workplace Responsibilities Office & AV technology: Driving the continuous improvement and development of our office technology and meeting rooms, while overseeing daily operations and support IT-Equipment Management: Managing IT equipment lifecycle operations (procurement, inventory logistics, and on/offboarding setups) for a device fleet consisting primarily of MacBooks, alongside an increasing number of Windows devices. Daily IT-support: Handling a broad variety of daily support requests from our end-users, both on-site and remote. Ranging from complex technical troubleshooting to routine, autopilot tasks Requirements & Qualifications Technical Experience: At least 3–5 years of experience working within IT operations, modern workplace management, or system administration. MDM & M365 Expertise: Proven experience configuring and administering Microsoft Intune (device configuration, compliance policies, deployment) and managing Microsoft 365 environments. Experience with multi-tenant setups is a major plus. Hands-on IT Support: Solid experience handling day-to-day workplace IT, end-user support, and hardware lifecycle management. Advanced Workstation & OS Expertise: Deep technical knowledge of both Windows and macOS ecosystems, naturally becoming the go-to person in the team for anything related to computer management and troubleshooting. Bonus Platform Knowledge: Experience with Okta, Google Workspace and Jamf is a strong advantage. Language: Professional fluency in English, both written and spoken. Who You Are To thrive in this position, we are looking for a specific mindset and personality. We believe you recognize yourself in the following: Autonomous & Driven: You don't wait for instructions. headline: Consent & Privacy Technology Specialist
description_text: About Schibsted Schibsted is a leading digital media company in the Nordics, reaching millions of users every day through trusted news brands and digital services. In this role, you will own and evolve the consent and privacy technology ecosystem that powers our data-driven products, advertising solutions, and personalized experiences across Schibsted's portfolio of media brands. You will play a critical role in ensuring that user consent is collected, managed, and activated in a compliant, scalable, and user-centric way. Working closely with Product, Engineering, Data, Legal, Privacy, Analytics, and Commercial teams, you will translate privacy regulations into practical technical implementations that enable responsible innovation. This is an opportunity to shape how millions of users interact with privacy choices while helping Schibsted strengthen trust, transparency, and sustainable growth. What You'll Do Support and manage Schibsted's consent management platform and related privacy technologies. Design, implement, and optimize end-to-end consent signal flows across websites, apps, advertising systems, and data platforms. Translate GDPR, ePrivacy, and other regulatory requirements into scalable technical solutions and consent logic. Partner with Product, Engineering, Legal, and Data teams to ensure privacy-by-design principles are embedded into new initiatives. Drive improvements in consent collection, consent quality, and user transparency. Support integration of consent signals into personalization, analytics, advertising, and customer data platforms. Monitor industry developments, browser changes, and privacy technology trends, identifying opportunities and risks for Schibsted. Act as a subject matter expert on consent and privacy technology across the organization. What We're Looking For Hands-on experience working with Consent Management Platforms (CMPs), such as OneTrust, Didomi, Sourcepoint, Usercentrics, or similar solutions. Strong understanding of digital advertising and marketing technology ecosystems, including web tracking, identity, audience activation, and measurement. Experience translating privacy and regulatory requirements into technical requirements Familiarity with GDPR, ePrivacy regulations, and privacy-first data practices. Knowledge of the IAB TCF, consent signalling standard like Google Consent Mode, and tracking technologies. Proven ability to collaborate effectively across technical, product, commercial, and legal stakeholders. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a pragmatic mindset. Nice to Have Basic knowledge or willingness to learn JavaScript for CMP template updates Experience from digital media, publishing, ad tech, marktech, or subscription businesses. Experience working with first-party data strategies and personalization platforms. Experience working with data platforms, tagging frameworks, analytics solutions, or customer data infrastructure. At Schibsted, you'll work on products that matter to society while helping shape the future of digital experiences. We believe diverse perspectives make us stronger. If you're excited about this role but don't meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. Curiosity, initiative, and a willingness to learn are qualities we value highly.

headline: AI First System Engineer
description_text: Cambio is one of the Nordics' leading suppliers in e-health with a comprehensive offering for the entire health and care chain. Our e-health solutions supports health care professionals in their daily work and offer patients safer and more easily accessible care. We are proud to be an important part of Swedish healthcare. We are growing continuously and now have about 1000 employees in several countries. The position As an AI First System Engineer at Cambio, you’ll design and build the intelligent systems powering the future of healthcare. This is not about adding AI on top — it’s about rethinking how systems are built from the ground up in an AI-first world. You’ll work at the intersection of architecture, AI, and product, shaping scalable and resilient solutions that enable new ways for millions of people to connect with healthcare. From defining system design and data flows to integrating AI capabilities into real-world applications, you’ll have a direct impact on how Cambio's HealthCare product evolves. You’ll operate in an autonomous and highly collaborative environment alongside Product teams and external stakeholders — while also helping set the standard for how Cambio builds modern, AI-native systems. We offer A true greenfield opportunity where you’ll help define not just features — but systems, architecture, and ways of working. Built on Cambio’s deep domain knowledge and best practices, this initiative takes an AI-first approach from day one. You’ll be an early adopter and a pioneer, shaping both the product and how we approach engineering across R&D. We believe in pragmatism, iteration, and building things that actually work in reality. We move fast, make decisions, and continuously improve — with efficiency as our team’s north star. About you We believe you're a curious and technically strong engineer who enjoys solving complex, real-world problems together with a talented team. You think in systems, not just features, and you're motivated by building solutions that are scalable, robust, and meaningful. You’re interested in how AI can fundamentally reshape how systems are designed — not just enhance existing ones. You’ll thrive in this role if you enjoy a fast-paced environment where ownership, transparency, and accountability are key. You bring a positive mindset, approach challenges with pragmatism, and keep a clear view of the bigger picture. At Cambio, we value initiative and personal growth. Our culture is built on Trust, Care, and Together—values we believe are important to both our work and our people. It’s important to us that you recognize and identify with these values. Requirements • Strong hands-on experience across frontend and backend development (code style does not matter). Strong backend experience is a plus. • Deep expertise in AI and applied AI solutions (you have built private and professional products and systems). • Solid systems engineering background — you understand how complex, distributed systems are designed, integrated, and scaled. • Proven experience taking products from concept through to launch and into live operation — you've owned the full lifecycle, not just parts of it. • Comfortable running and maintaining production systems, with a strong sense of reliability, observability, and operational ownership. It's a bonus if you have • Experience working with and optimizing Agentic/robotic or automated systems. Place of employment : Linköping or Stockholm Scope : Full-time, hybrid work model (three days per week in-office) Form of employment: Permanent employment, 6 months trial period Additional Information: The role involves access to sensitive information, therefore a background check will be conducted on the final candidate. We review applications and conduct interviews on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible via the link. We look forward to receiving your application! headline: Product Designer
description_text: Stories have the power to make the ordinary extraordinary. They help us think bigger, see beyond ourselves, and deepen our connection with others. This role is crucial for delivering on our 2026 Product & Tech ambitions. We’re looking for a designer who wants to build — someone energized by crafting and shipping meaningful experiences. You’re comfortable understanding the broader strategy, but you’re most motivated by turning it into tangible, elegant solutions with strong execution. You’ll join a tight-knit team of four designers within a strong Product & Tech organization, where the foundation is solid and the ambition is to raise the bar even higher. You’ll manage the design process for initiatives end-to-end, with support from your Design Manager, working closely with Product and Engineering to shape and ship thoughtful, high-quality experiences. We’re looking for someone proactive and hands-on — a designer who turns ambiguity into clear, elegant solutions and takes pride in what goes live. We intentionally build time into our projects for experimentation with new AI tools and workflows, and we expect designers to actively explore how emerging technologies can improve both the product experience and how we work. This is an individual contributor role. In our small design team, growth is measured by impact and influence rather than titles or management tracks. We value depth of craft, ownership, and the ability to consistently raise the bar. Key Responsibilities: Should demonstrate excellent collaboration skills. Taking responsibility for the user experience across all phases—from discovery and concept development to final implementation Translating insights into clear, evidence-based design decisions, and confidently communicating and advocating them across teams. Crafting high-quality, accessible UI aligned with our Digital Identity and Design System, supported by thoughtful interaction and prototyping. Collaborating closely with Product Managers and Engineers to shape, build, and ship impactful solutions. Driving innovative yet feasible design solutions that balance user value, business goals, and technical constraints. Ensuring strong design execution during implementation by working hands-on with developers. Measuring and evaluating shipped solutions, using data and insights to continuously refine and improve the experience. Facilitating workshops and design discussions to align stakeholders and move initiatives forward. Compensation & Benefits The anticipated monthly salary for this role is competitive and falls within the range of 45,000 to 55,000, depending on experience and qualifications. We provide a competitive benefits package that supports our employees' wellbeing, work-life balance, retirement savings options, and career development. About you To be successful in this role, we believe that you have: 3+ years of experience in product design for digital products You have solid experience designing and shipping digital products, with ownership from discovery through implementation. You’re comfortable turning ambiguity into clear, well-crafted solutions. You are highly proficient in Figma and comfortable working with modern tools for prototyping and building product ideas. You think beyond individual features and understand how design decisions connect to business goals, technical constraints, and long-term product quality. You communicate your thinking clearly and confidently, adapting your message to engineers, product managers, and stakeholders. You collaborate well and know how to move work forward. You bring strong craft and attention to detail, with advanced skills in Figma and prototyping tools — but your value lies in your judgment, not just your tools. You’re comfortable in a fast-paced environment and adapt your methods to the problem and team at hand. You actively seek and give constructive feedback. You’re comfortable having your work challenged and don’t take critique personally — your focus is on creating the best possible outcome. You’re curious, open to new perspectives, and motivated to continuously improve your craft and explore new ways of working. You take initiative and ownership. You proactively look for improvements and take initiative within your assigned problem space. Join a world of stories At Storytel, we're a team of creative story lovers who thrive on collaboration and new ideas. Our workplace is friendly, dynamic, and full of opportunities to experiment and make an impact. We believe in trust, flat hierarchies, and empowering you to grow with us. Answer a few questions, and you're all set.

headline: Credit Analyst
description_text: Get an idea of the role As a Credit Analyst in the Retail Finance B2C team, you'll spend most of your time close to the data - understanding how credits flow works, how lending strategies perform, and where there are opportunities to do things better. We foster a welcoming and supportive culture, where collaboration drives us to achieve the best outcomes for our users. Apply today! Don’t wait to send in your application. headline: Senior Platform Engineer
description_text: Stories have the power to make the ordinary extraordinary. They help us think bigger, see beyond ourselves, and deepen our connection with others. As one of the world's leading audiobook and e-book streaming platforms, Storytel brings unlimited listening to millions of users across 25 markets. Driven by our purpose, "Leading the future of storytelling, we move the world through stories", Storytel Group inspires and entertains people around the world by blending innovation with tradition. We bring stories to life across various formats for everyone to discover. Anytime. Anywhere. Ready for your next chapter? We're looking for a Senior Platform Engineer to join our Platform Engineering team! About the Team The Platform Engineering team focuses on setting up, operating and redefining observability, infrastructure, CI/CD, runtime, Machine Learning and AI agentic tooling at Storytel. We apply software engineering principles to accelerate software delivery and ensure that application development teams are productive in all aspects of the software delivery lifecycle. We aim to design and build toolchains and workflows covering the operational necessities of the entire lifecycle of an application and to enable that as self-service for our teams. This means providing paved roads that make it easy for our application developers to focus on building a great experience for our users. We support the teams in making the most of our platform's capabilities and in providing best-practices knowledge. Our team's expertise is very diverse, varying from cloud infrastructure, through security, to development tools, ML platform tooling, AI and more. About the Role Take the next step in your career as a Senior Platform Engineer at Storytel! At Storytel, engineers are viewed as leaders within the Individual Contributor roles, aiming to create impact and drive initiatives to bring our audio entertainment service to millions of users. As a senior member of the Platform team, you will design, build and maintain the toolchains and workflows that help our teams manage the full life-cycle of their systems – including tools, libraries for our common languages, templates, automation, and configurations. You'll work across observability, deployment pipelines, quality assurance, availability, the runtime platform. A key focus of this role is our ML platform capabilities. With AI and LLMs becoming a strategic part of how Storytel builds product experiences we need someone who can shape the paved road for ML workloads on Google Cloud and Vertex AI – making it easy for product teams to develop, deploy, and operate ML-powered features safely and reliably. Python is the lingua franca of this space and a key language for the role. You'll also coach and unblock developers in their daily work, help them get the most out of the platform, and lead initiatives that improve developer experience across the organisation. You will work with technologies including Metaflow, Argo Workflows, Argo Events, ArgoCD, Kargo, GitHub, GitHub Actions, Grafana, Prometheus, Kubernetes, Google Cloud Platform (including Vertex AI), Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Atlantis), Fastly, and more. About You To be successful in this role, we believe that you have: A platform engineering mindset. You understand that the job is about empowering other engineers to do their absolute best work, and you measure your success by their productivity and happiness. A software engineer's perspective. You've been in the shoes of an application developer and you understand the friction, the trade-offs, and the long feedback loops engineers deal with every day. Significant hands-on experience with ML on Google Cloud, and specifically Vertex AI – building, deploying, or operating ML workloads, pipelines, or platform capabilities that other teams build on top of. Strong Python skills in this context are expected. A deep care for developer experience. You believe that good DX has a direct, positive impact on team morale, delivery speed, and product quality – and you can point to things you've built that prove it. Strong long-term thinking on architecture. You weigh the maintenance cost of every decision and prefer boring, durable solutions over clever ones that someone else will have to live with. Pragmatic ambition. You have high standards and a vision for where the platform should go, but you also understand the constraints of working in a small organisation and know how to ship value incrementally. At least 5 years of professional software engineering experience, with solid hands-on development skills.. Strong experience with container technologies, Kubernetes, and distributed systems in production. Strong experience with a major cloud provider – ideally Google Cloud Platform. Experience working in DevEx-adjacent areas such as deployment pipelines, observability and monitoring, quality assurance, automation, self-service tooling, or runtime platforms. An ability to communicate fluently in English (written and spoken) and to collaborate effectively across teams – this role does not work in isolation. headline: Butikssäljare till Partille
description_text: Letar du efter en arbetsplats för framtiden? Att besöka en av Telenors butiker ska vara en upplevelse i världsklass! Våra kunder bemöts därför av personal med god kunskap om våra produkter och tjänster. Vi strävar alltid efter att hitta den bästa lösningen för varje kund och göra det komplicerade enkelt i alla lägen. Så letar du efter en arbetsplats där du får vara med och bidra till det viktigaste som finns – relationerna mellan människor? Då är du välkommen till oss på Telenor! Är du den vi söker? Vi behöver dig som är på tårna! Du har en genuin vilja att lära och utvecklas så att vi kan möta kunders ständigt föränderliga behov – idag och imorgon. Driv och engagemang är något vi värderar högt, och vi ser det som en grund för att skapa resultat och långsiktig framgång. Vi söker dig som har disciplin i ditt arbete – du tar ansvar och ser till att dina uppgifter blir gjorda på ett effektivt sätt. Du ser möjligheter där andra ser hinder och tar initiativ för att skapa de bästa förutsättningarna – både för kunden, teamet och dig själv. För att söka denna tjänst behöver du ha fyllt 18 år och behärska svenska i både tal och skrift. Du ska även vara student och ha minst 6 månader kvar av dina studier. Det är även meriterande om du har tidigare erfarenhet av kundkontakt, exempelvis inom kundservice eller försäljning, antingen över telefon eller i butik. Har du dessutom grundläggande kunskaper i säljteknik ser vi det som ett stort plus. Så kommer du göra skillnad hos oss Som butikssäljare befinner du dig i hjärtat av vår verksamhet – i kundmötet. Att öppna dörrarna till butiken, innebär att komma rakt in i pulsen. Det är här vi hjälper våra kunder att få ett bättre abonnemang, den senaste hårdvaran eller att fixa fakturastrulet. Det handlar helt enkelt om att få bort vardagens störningsmoment så att våra kunder kan fokusera på det viktiga i livet. Ge kundservice i världsklass: Du möter kunderna där de är, och skapa en upplevelse som överträffar förväntningarna. Rådgivning: Genom att kombinera produktkunskap och lyhördhet guidar du kunden till rätt lösningar. Bidra till kampanjer och aktiviteter: Du håller dig uppdaterad om aktuella erbjudanden och bidrar till en trivsam och engagerande butiksmiljö för alla besökare. Hålla butiken i toppskick : I nära samarbete med teamet säkerställer du en trivsam, välorganiserad och inbjudande butiksmiljö. Våra löften till dig Vi är bättre tillsammans . Hos oss möts du av en familjär och inkluderande kultur, en stark gemensam värdegrund och ett ledarskap som ger dig frihet och handlingskraft. Vi tror på att ge varandra förtroende och frihet att agera och fatta beslut, samtidigt som vi är där för varandra i med- och motgångar. Vi stöttar relationer och samhällen . Telenor är ett samhällsbärande företag och här får ditt arbete ett större syfte. Vi skapar värde för miljoner människor varje dag och har ett kundnära förhållningssätt där mänskliga relationer står i centrum. Vi ger plats för livet . Vi finns där genom livets alla faser och erbjuder trygghetspaket i form av bl.a. kollektivavtal, tjänstepension, friskvårdsbidrag och möjlighet att skräddarsy försäkringslösningar som passar just dig, för ditt behov här och nu. Som tillsvidareanställd har du dessutom vår förmån "två give-me-a-break-days" per år som ger dig en extra paus med möjlighet till återhämtning och välmående. Vi bjuder in till en spännande karriärresa . Din utveckling står i centrum och hos oss är lärande en del av kulturen. I butikerna fokuserar vi på att coacha, utveckla och ge dig rätt verktyg för att trivas och växa. Telenor erbjuder både fysiska och digitala utbildningar anpassade för just din utvecklingsresa. Genom Växa, vår utbildningsplattform, och andra lärandeinitiativ får du därmed möjligheten att utvecklas och forma din egen karriär. Majoriteten av våra tjänster tillsätts internt så när du vill vidare väntar möjligheterna här. Sök till oss idag Vill du ta ditt nästa steg i karriären med oss? Vi ser fram emot din ansökan! Vi träffar kandidater löpande så hör av dig redan idag. Observera att vi inte tar emot ansökningar via mejl. headline: Android Developer
description_text: Do you enjoy building polished mobile experiences that people use every day? Do you care about thoughtful engineering, clean architecture, and creating apps that feel fast, reliable, and intuitive? Then this could be the role for you. As part of our vision to enrich people’s lives through stories, we’re growing our Apps team by hiring an Android Developer to help us build seamless listening experiences for hundreds of thousands of users across Sweden, Norway, and Finland. About this position In this role, you’ll help shape how users experience our premium podcast and audiobook platform. You'll work closely with design, product, backend, QA, and DevOps to ensure the Podme Android app is high-performing, user-friendly, and continuously improving. You'll also contribute to technical decisions, feature design, and the ongoing evolution of our Android platform. What You'll Do Contribute to the implementation of scalable and modern architecture as defined by the team Develop, test, and deploy high-quality Android applications using Kotlin and Jetpack Compose Write clean, readable, and well-tested code in line with team standards Participate in code reviews and technical discussions with the team Collaborate across functions to help define, design, and deliver impactful product features Work closely with QA to support automation and ensure application stability Identify and address technical debt while contributing to continuous improvements of the codebase Evaluate and help introduce new tools, libraries, and development practices where appropriate What You Bring You're an Android developer who enjoys building user-focused products and takes ownership of delivering high-quality solutions while working closely with product, design, backend and QA. You have around 3–5 years of experience developing Android applications You have a solid understanding of Kotlin and the Android SDK You have hands-on experience with Jetpack libraries , especially Compose and Navigation You understand REST APIs and common mobile architecture patterns such as MVVM or Clean Architecture You are familiar with automated testing frameworks such as Espresso and JUnit You take ownership of your work and proactively drive tasks to completion You enjoy sharing knowledge and contributing to technical discussions and team improvements You have strong communication and collaboration skills Bonus skills Experience with media playback or streaming applications Experience working with subscription-based consumer products Why Join Podme? We offer an environment where you can have real impact, collaborate with experienced engineers, and continue growing your technical and product development skills . We also offer: Strong engineering culture built on trust, autonomy, and continuous improvement Flexible working hours and hybrid setup with three days per week in our Stockholm office (remote work is not an option) Solid AI tooling to support you with your work International collaboration with teammates across Stockholm, Kraków and Sarajevo Great benefits through Schibsted: private healthcare, wellness allowance Free access to Schibsted's media products including premium news and podcasts Who we are Podme is the place for premium podcasts and audiobooks. With over 350,000 paying subscribers, we’re available in Sweden, Norway, and Finland, and part of Schibsted Media since 2021. Our vision is to enrich people’s lives through stories, which embodies our core belief in the power of narratives to bring joy, meaning, and connection to individuals. We strive to create effortless and habit-forming audio and product experiences that resonate with the listener and add value in their everyday lives. We’re a friendly and passionate team of 80+ people, here to make listening effortless, inspiring, and part of everyday life. Backed by Schibsted Media , the largest media group in Scandinavia, we are now on a growth journey to build great product experiences for listeners across the Nordics.

headline: Credit Risk Analyst SME
description_text: Are you a challenger who wants to shape the future of credit risk for Business Loans to Small and Medium-sized Enterprises (SME)? At Nordax Bank , we believe in simplicity, transparency, and technology-driven innovation. As part of NOBA Bank Group , we offer consumer loans, credit cards, savings accounts and insurance – all made available through cutting-edge technology, automation, and seamless self-service platforms. With over 2 million customers across Norway, Sweden, Denmark, Finland, Germany, and Spain, we’re proud to be part of the largest independent specialist consumer finance lender in the Nordics – and we’re just getting started. This is an opportunity to join a bank that is growing fast and shaping the future of Small Medium Enterprises (SME) business loans in the Nordics. Why join us? We put professional development at the core of our success. At Nordax, you’ll find an international and friendly workplace with a flat structure, informal culture and high level of trust and autonomy. We’re currently around 200 employees at Bank Norwegian, and over 600 across the Nordax Bank . Our culture is built on collaboration, curiosity, and shared success — and we’re proud to live by our values: 💛 We are wholehearted 🤝 We collaborate 🚀 We take the lead About the team Our Credit & Analytics department is known for being one of the most forward-thinking in the Nordics, made up of talents from across the globe. Within this department, the Credit Underwriting & Decision Analytics unit focuses on continuously improving our automated underwriting processes and monitoring risk performance. We are now launching our SME business loans in the Nordics. As we build this business from the ground up, we’re looking for a Credit Risk Analyst SME with strong credit risk experience within the corporate lending business to play a key role in shaping our future solutions, policies, and risk strategies. This is a unique opportunity to be at the forefront of a new business area and make a real impact from day one. What you’ll be doing Play a central role in developing and launching the SME business loans in the Nordics Collaborate with business, product, and cross-functional teams on projects and initiatives, providing credit risk expertise into business decisions Work with data and data structures to ensure we have the right foundation for monitoring SME credit risk and processes, and to connect these insights directly to business and credit risk outcomes Contribute to continuous improvement of credit risk strategies, tools, process improvements and efficiency Develop and enhance data-driven monitoring and reporting to support proactive risk management for SME portfolios as the business grows Understand how data flows through our systems and processes, and leverage this knowledge to identify business opportunities, improve decision-making, and optimize operations Communicate findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. Collaborate on various tasks within Credit Underwriting & Decision Analytics to support our continuous improvement journey What we’re looking for Minimum 5 years’ experience working within credit risk and the credit environment for SME business loans in the Swedish market In-depth knowledge of credit risk assessment, credit bureau data, regulatory requirements, and market-specific credit risk factors related to SME loans Strong analytical skills, including the ability to interpret complex data and present findings clearly Fluency in English (Scandinavian language skills is a plus) Strong communication skills – ability to explain complex findings in an understandable way Working experience from using analytical tools such R, Python, SAS or SQL/Databricks A degree in a quantitative field (Economics, Finance, Statistics, Data Science or similar) Experience with fraud detection, prevention, and related controls within the SME loans is a strong plus Nice to have: Familiarity with reporting tools such as Tableau or Power BI Exposure to cloud platforms (e.g. AWS, Azure, GCP) Who you are You are creative, curious, and have strong analytical skills. You enjoy using data to challenge and improve existing methods and are eager to drive business improvements. You have a talent for seeing how data flows through and impacts business processes, and you use this understanding to identify opportunities, solve problems, and create value. You thrive in a collaborative environment, working closely with colleagues from different backgrounds, and are comfortable taking initiative and responsibility in projects. You have a commercial mindset and are motivated by making a tangible impact on both risk management and business outcomes. What we offer A dynamic, international and tech-driven workplace Significant responsibility as being for a portfolio Great collaboration with experienced and supportive colleagues Competitive salary and benefits Flexible working hours and hybrid setup A flat and informal organization with a startup mentality — but with the stability of an established bank Have you heard of NOBAVERSE? In our NOBAVERSE, we value openness, trust, and diversity. Here, you can influence your own development and have fun along the way to achieving our goals – all in a workplace that’s a little extra bubbly ! ✨ Read more about our employee value proposition on our careers page. Read more about how our recruitment process works in the FAQ . We care for your privacy and, with reference to the GDPR, would like to ask you not to include any sensitive personal data in your application, for examples information about ethnic origin, political opinions, religious beliefs or information about your health. Read more about how we handle your personal data here . If you have any questions or concerns about the position, please contact the responsible recruiter. We look forward to receiving your application! 🙏✨

headline: Sales Associate
description_text: Vi söker en engagerad Sales Associate till Resurs Brinner du för att hjälpa människor, älskar kundkontakt och drivs av tydliga mål? Då kan detta vara din nästa karriärmöjlighet! Som Sales Associate på Resurs blir du en viktig del i vårt ambitiösa team, där vi ständigt motiverar och utmanar varandra för att nå resultat tillsammans. Om rollen I rollen som Sales Associate hjälper du våra kunder till en tryggare och smartare privatekonomi. Genom både utgående samtal till befintliga kunder och inkommande ärenden via telefon och webb, kartlägger du kundernas behov och erbjuder lösningar som gör skillnad. Med en bred produktportfölj – som samlingslån, betalförsäkringar, kreditkort och sparkonton – guidar du kunderna rätt, samtidigt som du bygger långsiktiga relationer och bidrar till teamets gemensamma framgång. Dina arbetsuppgifter: Kartlägga kunders behov och erbjuda skräddarsydda lösningar Arbeta med ett brett produktutbud inom lån, försäkringar, kreditkort och sparande Bygga långsiktiga kundrelationer och skapa trygghet genom hela kundresan Driva din egen försäljning och arbeta målinriktat för att nå KPI:er och försäljningsmål Delta i daglig coaching, pulsmöten och bidra till teamets energi och resultat Vi tror att du har: Fömåga att skapa förtroende och bygga relationer via telefon och digitala kanaler Struktur i ditt administrativa arbete och förmåga att hålla ordning även under intensiva perioder En målfokuserad och lösningsorienterad inställning, utan att tumma på kundupplevelsen Erfarenhet av försäljning är meriterande – men viktigast är din potential och vilja att utvecklas En positiv attityd som smittar av sig på både kunder och kollegor Vi söker dig som kombinerar driv, energi och en passion för kundservice. Du är en god kommunikatör, trivs i en snabbföränderlig miljö och vill utvecklas inom försäljning. Varför välja Resurs? Hos oss på Resurs är du mer än bara en säljare – du är en viktig del av vår resa framåt. Vi erbjuder en modern arbetsplats i fräscha lokaler på vårt huvudkontor på Väla, Helsingborg. Vi har trygga anställningsvillkor och kollektivavtal, och alla anställda omfattas av förmåner som friskvårdsbidrag, massage, subventionerad lunch m.m. Ansök genom att skicka in ditt CV och en video – enkelt och personligt. Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning med sex månaders provanställning. Viktigt att känna till: På slutkandidater genomför vi en utförlig bakgrundskontroll via ett externt bolag.

headline: Spontanansökan: Jobba med oss på Omni
description_text: Vill du vara en del av Sveriges bästa redaktion? Omni har flera gånger prisats som Sveriges bästa nyhetstjänst och har både förändrat hur människor läser nyheter och moderniserat den redaktionella processen. Redaktörerna som jobbar hos oss är Sveriges bästa – och vi söker ständigt nya stjärnor! Omni är en liten och snabbrörlig redaktion som inte räds att pröva nya saker. Redaktörsrollen är lika rolig som utmanande och innebär i praktiken att du är nyhetschef, redaktör och reporter i ett. headline: Kundrådgivare

engagemang i kundens ekonomi Möta kunder i både fysiska möten på det lokala kontoret och i digitala rådgivningssamtal med kunder från hela landet – där varje möte präglas av lyhördhet, professionalism och hög servicekänsla Arbeta proaktivt med Swedbanks breda produktutbud, med särskilt fokus på bolån, och vägleda kunder mot trygga och hållbara finansiella beslut som stärker deras långsiktiga headline: DataOps Engineer
description_text: About the job Are you looking for a role where your engineering skills create real business value? As a DataOps Engineer in NOBA Bank Group, you’ll be instrumental in ensuring that raw data is efficiently transformed into structured, high-quality assets. You’ll play a key role in modernizing and maintaining our data infrastructure, implementing new technologies, and enabling the organization to innovate and grow through reliable, accessible, and well-managed data operations. About The Role The Data & Analytics Engineering department brings together specialists in data infrastructure, analytics, and data management. Together we build a modern and reliable data foundation that supports decision making across the business. This role is for Data Management & New Initiatives team under Data & Analytics Engineering department. In this role, you’ll design, develop, and maintain robust data pipelines, partner with teams across the bank, and ensure that business critical data needs are met. You will take responsibility for ensuring continuous operations of our data warehouse across all domains, making sure daily processes run smoothly and data is readily accessible for all users. You’ll also monitor data infrastructure performance, proactively troubleshoot issues, and collaborate with other engineers to develop our security and business continuity best-practices. This is a great opportunity to enjoy a high degree of self-responsibility and expand your expertise into areas of your interest. You’ll collaborate broadly and see the tangible results of your work. We offer a hybrid working model with two common in-office days. While we value flexibility, we also prioritize collaboration, team building, and enjoying fikas and after work gatherings together! Main Tasks Design, build, and maintain data pipelines using Databricks and dbt. Implement and manage CI/CD pipelines for data workflows. Collaborate with data engineers, analysts, and DevOps teams to ensure robust, scalable, and reliable data operations. Monitor data infrastructure performance and proactively perform troubleshooting to ensure high availability and reliability. Ensure data quality, security, and compliance throughout the data lifecycle. Monitor data infrastructure performance and proactively perform troubleshooting to ensure high availability and reliability. Enhance data usage and accessibility by applying modern data engineering practices Document processes and contribute to best practices. We Are Looking For You Who Enjoys working at the intersection of data engineering and operations, ensuring that data infrastructure is robust, efficient, and reliable. You are passionate about automating processes, monitoring systems, and proactively resolving issues to keep data flowing smoothly across the organization. You are proactive and detail-oriented, with a genuine curiosity for new technologies and best practices in Data. You thrive in collaborative environments, approach challenges with a “can-do” mindset, and enjoy transforming complex operational problems into practical, scalable solutions. You value a high degree of self-responsibility and are motivated to expand your expertise in areas that interest you, contributing to both the stability and innovation of our data platform. For This Role, You’ll Need Experience working in DataOps/ AI Ops, Data Engineering, or similar technical role focused on data infrastructure and operations. An academic degree in a relevant field such as data engineering, computer science, software engineering, or a related discipline. Strong proficiency in ETL processes and data logic, with a solid understanding of how data is sourced, transformed, and delivered to end users. Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure's data stack Practical experience working with both Databricks and dbt in a production environment. Ability to manage and automate data infrastructure resources (e.g., clusters, SQL Warehouses, permissions). Solid understanding of DevOps practices, including experience with version control systems and CI/CD tools. Excellent English communication skills, with a good understanding of Norwegian and/or Swedish considered an advantage. It's Positive If You Have Previous experience in data-focused roles within the financial sector. Familiarity with Agile and Scrum methodologies. Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code Our offer to you Freedom with responsibility: Flexible working arrangements to suit your work style and a high degree of self-responsibility. Career development: Opportunities to grow and develop in your role, and to expand your expertise into areas of your interest. Feedback culture: A supportive environment that encourages open communication. Coaching leadership: Managers who guide and support your career journey. A caring company culture: We genuinely care about each other! You’ll also have the chance to work with cutting-edge data technologies and be part of shaping the future of NOBA’s data landscape. In addition to this, it is important to us that you recognize yourself in our values: we are wholehearted , we collaborate and we take the lead . Practical information: Start: As soon as possible Location: Oslo/Stockholm Form of employment: Permanent position with probation period Extent: Full-time Working hours: Regular office hours Have you heard of NOBAVERSE? In our NOBAVERSE, we value openness, trust, and diversity. Here, you can influence your own development and have fun along the way to achieving our goals – all in a workplace that’s a little extra bubbly ! ✨ Read more about our employee value proposition on our careers page. Read more about how our recruitment process works in the FAQ .
